title: nasturtium ruderale
intro: Nasturtium ruderale, commonly known as Mexican tarragon or Indian cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used for its medicinal properties and has been reported to have health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing stress, anxiety, and inflammation, and it has been used to treat various health conditions such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Nasturtium ruderale include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
